summaryZh: 有氧加肌力訓練，肌力、爆發力和肌肥大跟只練肌力差不多，有氧能力進步更多（SMD 0.77）；受試者多是一般有訓練的人。
claims: Compared with resistance training alone, concurrent training gave comparable strength, power and hypertrophy outcomes while improving aerobic capacity more (SMD 0.77), in 1492 healthy, mostly recreationally trained people.
Training sequence had no significant effect overall; the authors describe trends that lifting before cardio may favor strength (SMD 1.69) and hypertrophy (SMD 0.83, p = 0.36).
Data from highly trained to elite athletes were scarce, so these results apply mainly to recreationally trained people.
population: 17 meta-analyses covering 144 studies and 1492 healthy participants, mostly recreationally trained
certainty: moderate for recreationally trained adults; umbrella of overlapping meta-analyses; little data on highly trained athletes
terms: 有氧 重量 一起練 干擾 掉肌肉 cardio interference concurrent 跑步 騎車 腳踏車

source.author: Held
source.title: Maximizing Adaptations in Concurrent Training: An Umbrella Review of Meta-analyses

summaryZh: 加有氧不影響最大肌力（SMD −0.06）和肌肥大（−0.01），但爆發力進步較少（−0.28），同一次訓練做時更明顯。
claims: Adding aerobic training to the same strength program did not reduce maximal strength gains (SMD -0.06, 95% CI -0.20 to 0.09) or muscle hypertrophy (SMD -0.01) across 43 studies in healthy adults.
Explosive strength gains were modestly blunted (SMD -0.28, 95% CI -0.48 to -0.08).
The explosive-strength blunting was more pronounced when aerobic and strength training were done in the same session than when sessions were separated by at least 3 hours.
No moderating effect was found for cycling vs running, more vs fewer than 5 weekly sessions, untrained vs active participants, or age under vs over 40.
population: 43 studies, healthy adults of any sex and age, supervised concurrent training for at least 4 weeks compared with an identical strength program alone; untrained or active, not elite
certainty: moderate; 43 studies, but participants were untrained or recreationally active, so it says little about trained lifters
terms: 有氧 重量 爆發力 干擾 同一天 cardio lifting power same session

source.author: Schumann
source.title: Compatibility of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Training for Skeletal Muscle Size and Function: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 肌肥大效果量：只練肌力 1.23、合併 0.85；搭配跑步（不是騎車）會減少肌肥大和肌力，有氧越頻繁、越久，進步越少。
claims: Mean effect sizes for hypertrophy were 1.23 for strength training alone, 0.85 for concurrent training and 0.27 for endurance training alone; strength and concurrent training were both significantly greater than endurance only.
For power, effect sizes were 0.91 for strength training alone, 0.55 for concurrent training and 0.11 for endurance only, and all three groups differed significantly.
Resistance training combined with running, but not with cycling, was linked to significant decrements in hypertrophy and strength.
More frequent and longer endurance training correlated with smaller hypertrophy, strength and power gains (r -0.26 to -0.35 for frequency, -0.29 to -0.75 for duration).
population: 21 studies (422 effect sizes) comparing strength training alone, endurance training alone and concurrent training
certainty: low to moderate; older analysis of 21 mostly short studies; the dose and modality findings are moderator and correlation results, not direct comparisons
terms: 有氧 重量 一起練 干擾 掉肌肉 cardio interference concurrent 跑步 騎車 腳踏車

source.author: Wilson
source.title: Concurrent training: a meta-analysis examining interference of aerobic and resistance exercises
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

claims: At the muscle-fiber level, concurrent training showed a small negative effect on fiber hypertrophy compared with strength training alone (SMD -0.23, 95% CI -0.46 to -0.00, p = 0.050) across 15 studies.
Type I fiber growth was blunted when the aerobic training was running (SMD -0.81, 95% CI -1.26 to -0.36) but not cycling; the authors call this preliminary.
population: 15 studies, healthy adults of any sex and age, supervised concurrent training for at least 4 weeks vs an identical strength program alone, muscle fiber size from biopsies
certainty: low; 15 small biopsy studies, borderline overall effect (p = 0.050), running vs cycling based on a subgroup
terms: 有氧 干擾 肌纖維 cardio interference fiber 跑步 騎車 腳踏車

source.author: Lundberg
source.title: The Effects of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Training on Muscle Fiber Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 有訓練經驗的人，合併訓練讓 1RM 進步較少（ES −0.35），但只發生在同一次訓練一起做時（−0.66），分開練沒差；新手不受影響。
claims: Concurrent training reduced leg press and squat 1RM gains compared with resistance training only in trained individuals (ES -0.35), but not in moderately trained (ES -0.20, p = 0.08) or untrained individuals (ES 0.03).
In trained individuals the negative effect appeared only when resistance and endurance training were done in the same session (ES -0.66), not in different sessions (ES -0.10, p = 0.55).
population: 27 studies comparing concurrent training with resistance training only on lower-body 1RM (leg press, squat), split by training status
certainty: low to moderate; the same-session finding comes from a subgroup analysis of the trained studies
terms: 有經驗 有氧 干擾 trained lifters concurrent

source.author: Petré
source.title: Development of Maximal Dynamic Strength During Concurrent Resistance and Endurance Training in Untrained, Moderately Trained, and Trained Individuals: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 合併訓練讓男性下肢肌力進步略少（SMD −0.43），女性沒有（0.08）。
claims: Concurrent training produced a small blunting of lower-body strength gains in males (SMD -0.43, 95% CI -0.64 to -0.22) but not in females (SMD 0.08), with a significant difference between sexes.
No sex differences were found for upper-body strength or power changes.
Data on muscle hypertrophy were insufficient to draw conclusions.
population: 59 studies, 1346 healthy adults aged 18-50, interventions of at least 4 weeks
certainty: low to moderate; small effect; the authors note few studies in females and in highly trained athletes

source.author: Huiberts
source.title: Concurrent Strength and Endurance Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis on the Impact of Sex and Training Status

claims: Concurrent HIIT and resistance training led to similar changes in muscle hypertrophy and upper-body strength as resistance training alone.
Lower-body strength increased less with concurrent HIIT than with resistance training alone (ES -0.248, p = 0.049).
In subanalyses, cycling HIIT showed a non-significant trend toward lower leg strength gains (ES -0.377, p = 0.074) while running HIIT did not (ES -0.176, p = 0.261).
population: studies comparing concurrent HIIT plus resistance training with resistance training alone (number of studies not stated in the abstract)
certainty: low; small effect at borderline significance; the running vs cycling result is only a trend and runs opposite to other meta-analyses
terms: HIIT 間歇 重量 干擾 HIIT interval interference

source.author: Sabag
source.title: The compatibility of concurrent high intensity interval training and resistance training for muscular strength and hypertrophy: a systematic review and meta-analysis

summaryZh: 整塊肌肉的生長不受有氧形式影響；肌纖維層級，含 HIIT 的組合長得較少。

population: 25 randomized and non-randomized studies comparing resistance training alone with concurrent training using continuous and/or interval endurance work
certainty: low; subgroup analyses, mix of randomized and non-randomized studies, fiber-level outcomes
terms: HIIT 穩定有氧 慢跑 干擾 HIIT continuous

source.author: Monserdà-Vilaró
source.title: Effects of Concurrent Resistance and Endurance Training Using Continuous or Intermittent Protocols on Muscle Hypertrophy: Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis

claims: Adding sprint interval training to resistance training did not reduce lower-body strength (SMD 0.01), upper-body strength (SMD -0.06), jump (SMD 0.11) or sprint performance (SMD -0.01) compared with resistance training alone, in 9 RCTs with 177 adults.

population: 9 RCTs, 177 healthy adults, sprint interval training plus resistance training vs resistance training alone
certainty: low; 9 small trials (177 participants); the abstract reports no hypertrophy result
terms: 衝刺 間歇衝刺 sprint interval

claims: Lifting before endurance exercise in the same session gave greater lower-body dynamic strength gains than the reverse order (weighted mean difference 6.91% change, 95% CI 1.96 to 11.87).
Order made no difference to lower-body hypertrophy (1.15% change, p = 0.40), lower-body static strength, maximal aerobic capacity or body fat percentage.
population: 10 studies, healthy adults, concurrent programs of at least 5 weeks comparing lifting-first with cardio-first sessions
certainty: low to moderate; 10 studies; only one of five outcomes affected
terms: 先有氧還是先重量 順序 cardio before or after weights order

source.author: Eddens
source.title: The Role of Intra-Session Exercise Sequence in the Interference Effect: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 先肌力後有氧，下肢 1RM 多 3.96 kg；有氧能力不受順序影響。
claims: Lower-body 1RM improved more when strength training came before endurance training in the same session (pooled mean difference 3.96 kg, 95% CI 0.81 to 7.10 kg).
Order had no effect on aerobic capacity (pooled mean difference 0.39 ml/kg/min, 95% CI -1.03 to 1.81).
population: chronic training trials comparing strength-then-endurance with endurance-then-strength in the same session (number of studies not stated in the abstract)
certainty: low to moderate; small absolute difference (about 4 kg)
terms: 先有氧還是先重量 順序 cardio before or after weights order

source.author: Murlasits
source.title: The physiological effects of concurrent strength and endurance training sequence: A systematic review and meta-analysis

summaryZh: 58 位業餘橄欖球員：兩種訓練間隔 0 小時肌力進步較少，隔 6 或 24 小時較好；作者建議至少隔 6 小時。
claims: Gains in bench press and half-squat maximal strength were lower when aerobic training followed strength with no recovery (0 h) than with 6 h or 24 h between them or with strength training alone, in 58 amateur rugby players over 7 weeks.
VO2peak gains were greater with 24 h between sessions than with 0 h or 6 h.
The authors advise not scheduling the two with less than 6 hours of recovery between them.
population: 58 amateur rugby players, 7 weeks, randomized to concurrent training with 0, 6 or 24 h between strength and aerobic sessions, strength only, or control; strength always done first
certainty: low; single 7-week trial in amateur rugby players, analyzed with magnitude-based inference
terms: 有氧和重量隔多久 分開練 recovery between sessions same day

source.author: Robineau
source.title: Specific Training Effects of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Exercises Depend on Recovery Duration
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 24 位有經驗男性：肌力和有氧 3:1 的頻率保住肌力進步，1:1 干擾較大。
claims: In 24 resistance-trained men, the strength-only and 3:1 strength-to-endurance groups had greater leg maximal voluntary contraction gains than the 1:1 group and controls over 6 weeks.
Strength training alone increased limb girth more than the 1:1 concurrent ratio.
The authors conclude that more frequent endurance training increased interference with strength and limb girth.
population: 24 men with more than 2 years of resistance training experience, 6 weeks at 3 days per week, isolated-limb model; strength only vs 3:1 or 1:1 strength-to-endurance ratios vs no training
certainty: low; small 6-week trial in men, isolated-limb model, limb girth is a crude size measure
terms: 有氧頻率 有氧量 干擾 cardio frequency interference

source.title: Performance and neuromuscular adaptations following differing ratios of concurrent strength and endurance training

Certainty of evidence was low to moderate.
population: network meta-analysis of 32 RCTs, 4774 adults with obesity (mean BMI 30 or above), training for at least 6 months

terms: 身體組成 減脂 體脂 減重 有氧還是重量 body composition fat loss weight loss

population: network meta-analysis of 45 RCTs, 3566 adults living with obesity

claims: Aerobic and combined training reduced total body mass and fat mass more than resistance training alone, with no difference between aerobic and combined, in 119 sedentary overweight or obese adults over 8 months.
Resistance and combined training increased lean body mass more than aerobic training.
Combined training took double the time but did not produce significantly more fat or body mass loss than aerobic training alone.
population: 119 sedentary, overweight or obese adults, 8 months of aerobic, resistance or combined training (STRRIDE AT/RT)
certainty: moderate for this population; single RCT in sedentary middle-aged adults
terms: 身體組成 減脂 體脂 減重 有氧還是重量 body composition fat loss weight loss

source.author: Willis
source.title: Effects of aerobic and/or resistance training on body mass and fat mass in overweight or obese adults

claims: Adding exercise to calorie restriction preserved fat-free mass compared with diet alone (+0.87 kg, 95% CI +0.59 to +1.16), preventing on average about 46% of fat-free mass loss, in 34 RCTs of people with overweight or obesity.

Pairwise subgroup testing found no significant differences between training modes.
population: 34 RCTs, 1455 people with overweight or obesity on calorie restriction, with or without strength, endurance or mixed training
certainty: moderate for exercise vs diet alone; low for differences between training modes (not significant in pairwise tests); muscle mass itself reported in only 2 studies

source.author: Garber
source.title: American College of Sports Medicine position stand. Quantity and quality of exercise for developing and maintaining cardiorespiratory, musculoskeletal, and neuromotor fitness in apparently healthy adults: guidance for prescribing exercise

summaryZh: 67 個研究：每週組數越多，肌肥大和肌力越好，但效益遞減，肌力遞減得更快；順帶練到的肌群算半組最符合資料；頻率幫肌力，對肌肥大影響可忽略。

source.author: Baz-Valle

Stopping at high velocity loss (more than 25%) was not better than moderate velocity loss (20-25%) for growth (effect size 0.08).
population: 15 studies in healthy adults of any age and training experience
certainty: low to moderate; 15 studies with inconsistent definitions of failure

source.author: Refalo
source.title: Influence of Resistance Training Proximity-to-Failure on Skeletal Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 全幅度比部分幅度肌力進步多（ES 0.56），下肢肌肥大也更多（0.88）。
claims: Across 16 studies, full range-of-motion training produced larger strength gains than partial range of motion (effect size 0.56).
Full range of motion produced more lower-limb hypertrophy (effect size 0.88).
Neither range was clearly better for changes in muscle thickness, pennation angle and fascicle length (effect size 0.28, p = 0.226).
population: 16 studies comparing full vs partial range-of-motion training; the abstract does not detail participants
certainty: low to moderate; 16 studies, and the abstract does not separate partials done at long vs short muscle lengths
terms: 全幅度 半程 動作幅度 range of motion partial reps

source.author: Pallarés
source.title: Effects of range of motion on resistance training adaptations: A systematic review and meta-analysis
source.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports

summaryZh: 全幅度，或在肌肉拉長位置做的部分幅度，比縮短位置的部分幅度長更多肌肉。
claims: Across 11 studies, full range of motion and partials in the initial part of the range produced more growth at the rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, biceps brachii and brachialis distal sites than partials in the final part of the range (between-group effect sizes 0.20-0.90).
Initial-range partials produced more proximal rectus femoris growth than full range of motion (effect sizes 0.35-0.38).
The authors conclude that training at longer muscle lengths, through either full range or partials, tends to give optimal growth in muscles such as the quadriceps, biceps and triceps.
population: 11 studies comparing full vs partial range of motion; effect sizes calculated per study, no pooled meta-analysis
certainty: low; 11 small studies, results differ by muscle, no pooled estimate
terms: 拉長位置 長肌肉長度 部分幅度 lengthened partials long muscle length

source.author: Kassiano
source.title: Which ROMs Lead to Rome? A Systematic Review of the Effects of Range of Motion on Muscle Hypertrophy
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 在較長的肌肉長度訓練，各部位肌肥大的優勢都很小（SMD 0.05–0.09），遠端略多；比較的長度差距不大。
claims: Across 12 studies, training at longer vs shorter mean muscle lengths gave trivial, precisely estimated differences in regional growth: SMD 0.05 proximal, 0.07 mid-belly, 0.09 distal.
The long-length benefit trended upward from proximal to distal sites (about 0.6%, 1.2% and 1.9% extra growth), but a high share of each estimate fell within the region of practical equivalence.
Conditions differed by only 21.8% in mean muscle length on average, so larger length contrasts remain untested.
population: 12 studies in young adults that manipulated mean muscle length via range of motion or exercise selection (Bayesian meta-analysis)
certainty: moderate that differences are small for modest length contrasts; uncertain for large contrasts
terms: 拉長位置 長肌肉長度 部分幅度 lengthened partials long muscle length

source.author: Varovic
source.title: Does Muscle Length Influence Regional Hypertrophy? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 練到力竭時，輕重量（≤60% 1RM）和大重量長的肌肉一樣多，但大重量的 1RM 進步較多。
claims: Across 21 studies with all sets taken to momentary failure, low loads (60% 1RM or less) and high loads (above 60% 1RM) produced similar muscle growth.
1RM strength gains were significantly greater with high loads, while isometric strength did not differ.
population: 21 studies in people without medical conditions; low load at or below 60% 1RM vs high load above 60% 1RM; all sets to momentary muscular failure; at least 6 weeks
certainty: moderate; 21 studies, but the equivalence for growth applies only when sets reach failure
terms: 重量 輕重量 大重量 次數 幾下 load heavy light reps

source.author: Schoenfeld
source.title: Strength and Hypertrophy Adaptations Between Low- vs. High-Load Resistance Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 練到力竭時，輕、中、重重量長的肌肉沒差；肌力以大、中重量較好（SMD 0.60–0.63）。
claims: Across 28 studies (747 adults) with sets to volitional failure, low, moderate and high loads produced no difference in muscle growth.
High and moderate loads beat low loads for strength (SMD 0.60-0.63 and 0.34-0.35); high vs moderate favored high loads (SMD 0.26-0.28) but not significantly (P = 0.068).
Untrained participants grew more, and among those with some training background, more sessions gave more growth.
population: 28 studies, 747 healthy adults; all sets to volitional failure; low (more than 15RM), moderate (9-15RM), high (8RM or fewer) loads
certainty: moderate; 28 studies with small samples
terms: 重量 輕重量 大重量 次數 幾下 load heavy light reps

source.author: Lopez
source.title: Resistance Training Load Effects on Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gain: Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis
source.journal: Medicine and Science in Sports and Exercise

summaryZh: 所有訓練處方都能增肌增力；>80% 1RM 最能提升肌力，增肌則各種處方差不多。
claims: Every resistance-training prescription beat no exercise for strength and size, across 178 strength studies (5,097 adults) and 119 hypertrophy studies (3,364 adults).
Higher loads (above 80% 1RM) maximised strength, while all prescriptions promoted hypertrophy comparably.

The top-ranked prescription for strength was higher-load, multiple sets, three times a week (SMD 1.60 vs control); for hypertrophy it was higher-load, multiple sets, twice a week (SMD 0.66 vs control).
population: Healthy adults; strength network 178 studies (n = 5,097; 45% women), hypertrophy network 119 studies (n = 3,364; 47% women)
certainty: moderate to high that all prescriptions work; the top rankings are close and the abstract reports them as robust
terms: 重量 輕重量 大重量 次數 幾下 load heavy light reps

source.author: Currier
source.title: Resistance training prescription for muscle strength and hypertrophy in healthy adults: a systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis

summaryZh: 總組數相同時，一週練幾次對肌肉成長沒有差別；總量不同時，頻率高稍有優勢。
claims: Across 25 studies, training a muscle more vs less often made no significant difference to growth when weekly volume was equated.
This held for direct growth measures, for resistance-trained people, and for upper and lower body.
In studies where volume was not equated, higher frequency had a significant but modest advantage between 1 and 3+ days per week.
population: 25 studies; subanalyses for resistance-trained people, direct growth measures, upper and lower body
certainty: moderate; 25 studies, and the authors call the volume-equated evidence strong
terms: 一週練幾次 頻率 練幾天 frequency sessions per week

source.author: Schoenfeld
source.title: How many times per week should a muscle be trained to maximize muscle hypertrophy? A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies examining the effects of resistance training frequency

summaryZh: 肌力效果量隨頻率上升（每週 1 到 4 次以上：0.74 到 1.08），但總量相同時頻率沒有影響。
claims: Across 22 studies, strength effect sizes rose with weekly frequency: 0.74, 0.82, 0.93 and 1.08 for 1, 2, 3 and 4+ sessions per week.
When volume was equated, frequency had no significant effect on strength gains (p = 0.421).
Higher frequency seemed to help more for multi-joint lifts, the upper body, women, and young rather than older adults.
population: 22 studies, mostly in untrained participants; most rated moderate methodological quality
certainty: low to moderate; 22 studies, mostly untrained participants, mostly moderate quality
terms: 一週練幾次 頻率 練幾天 frequency sessions per week

source.author: Grgic
source.title: Effect of Resistance Training Frequency on Gains in Muscular Strength: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 組間休息超過 60 秒對肌肥大有小幅好處，超過 90 秒後就沒有差別。
claims: In direct short-vs-longer rest comparisons, central estimates slightly favored longer rest for arm (0.13) and thigh (0.17) growth, with credible intervals crossing zero.
The authors conclude there is a small hypertrophy benefit to resting more than 60 s between sets, but no appreciable difference once rest exceeds 90 s.
population: 9 randomized studies (19 measurements) in healthy adults, with other training variables controlled
certainty: low; 9 studies, wide credible intervals, substantial heterogeneity
terms: 組間休息 休息多久 rest between sets

source.author: Singer
source.title: Give it a rest: a systematic review with Bayesian meta-analysis on the effect of inter-set rest interval duration on muscle hypertrophy
source.journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living

summaryZh: 有計畫地變換動作可能有幫助，過度、隨機地換動作可能妨礙進步。
claims: Across 8 studies (241 young men), the available evidence indicates that varying exercise selection can influence hypertrophy and strength gains.
Some systematic variation seemed to enhance regional hypertrophy and maximize dynamic strength, whereas excessive, random variation may compromise gains.
population: 8 studies, 241 participants, all young men
certainty: low; 8 studies, young men only, no meta-analysis
terms: 換動作 動作變化 exercise variation

source.author: Kassiano
source.title: Does Varying Resistance Exercises Promote Superior Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gains? A Systematic Review
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 單邊和雙邊訓練長的肌肉差不多；肌力有專一性，練哪種就哪種進步多。
claims: Across 9 studies, unilateral and bilateral training produced similar muscle growth (effect size -0.21, P = 0.57).
Bilateral training improved bilateral strength more (effect size 0.56), while unilateral training improved unilateral strength more (effect size -0.65 in favor of unilateral).
population: 9 studies; moderate risk of bias overall
certainty: low; 9 studies with moderate risk of bias
terms: 單邊 雙邊 unilateral bilateral

source.author: Kassiano
source.title: Comparison of Muscle Growth and Dynamic Strength Adaptations Induced by Unilateral and Bilateral Resistance Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 動作節奏快或慢，肌肉成長幾乎沒有差別。
claims: Across 14 studies, faster and slower repetition tempos produced similar growth (pooled within-group effects 0.43 faster vs 0.34 slower).
Direct comparisons trivially favored faster tempos (0.09, 95% CrI -0.04 to 0.22); the probability of at least a small difference was 0.45 and of a medium one 0.001.
The authors conclude tempo has minimal overall effect on hypertrophy, with possible differences only under specific conditions.
population: 14 studies in healthy adults with other variables controlled; slower = 1.7-4.5 s per rep (about 3.5 s), faster = 0.3-2 s (about 1 s); Bayesian analysis
certainty: low to moderate; 14 studies, tempos tested only up to about 4.5 s per rep
terms: 節奏 慢慢做 動作速度 tempo rep speed

source.author: Enes
source.title: How Slow Should You Go? A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis of the Effect of Resistance Training Repetition Tempo on Muscle Hypertrophy
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 總量相同時，週期化訓練讓 1RM 進步較多（ES 0.31），肌肥大沒差；波浪式比線性好只見於有訓練的人。
claims: With volume equated, periodized training gave larger 1RM gains than non-periodized training (effect size 0.31), but no difference in hypertrophy (effect size 0.13, P = 0.27).
Undulating beat linear periodization for 1RM (effect size 0.31), driven by trained participants (0.61); in untrained participants there was no difference (0.06).
Linear and undulating periodization did not differ for hypertrophy (effect size 0.05).
population: 35 volume-equated studies; trained and untrained subgroups
certainty: low to moderate; small effects with confidence intervals near zero
terms: 週期化 課表安排 波浪式 periodization

source.author: Moesgaard
source.title: Effects of Periodization on Strength and Muscle Hypertrophy in Volume-Equated Resistance Training Programs: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 有訓練的人 8 週：加次數和加重量效果相近。
claims: In 43 trained adults over 8 weeks, adding reps at a fixed load and adding load at a fixed rep range gave similar results, with no other notable between-group differences in muscle thickness, endurance, jump height, body fat or lean mass.

Rectus femoris growth modestly favored rep progression (2.8 mm summed across sites, CI -0.5 to 5.8), and squat 1RM slightly favored load progression (2.0 kg, CI -2.4 to 7.8); the authors call these differences of questionable practical significance.
population: 43 adults with at least 1 year of lower-body training (27 men, 16 women); 8 weeks; 4 sets of 4 lower-body exercises twice weekly
certainty: low; one 8-week RCT, lower body only, n = 43
terms: 加重量 加次數 漸進超負荷 progressive overload progression

source.author: Plotkin
source.title: Progressive overload without progressing load? The effects of load or repetition progression on muscular adaptations

summaryZh: 課程中途完全停練一週，肌肉成長相同，但下肢肌力進步較少。
claims: In 39 trained young adults, a full 1-week break from training mid-program gave similar lower-body muscle growth, local endurance and power as continuous training.
The continuous group gained more isometric and dynamic lower-body strength than the group that took the week off.
Continuous training also showed slight psychological benefits on a readiness-to-train questionnaire.
population: 39 resistance-trained young adults (29 men, 10 women); 9-week high-volume program; the 'deload' group stopped training entirely for 1 week at the midpoint
certainty: low; single 9-week RCT; the 'deload' was full cessation, not lighter training
terms: 減量週 休息一週 停練 deload week off

source.author: Coleman
source.title: Gaining more from doing less? The effects of a one-week deload period during supervised resistance training on muscular adaptations

summaryZh: 每練 6 週休 3 週，24 週下來肌肉和肌力進步跟連續訓練相近。
claims: In 14 young men over 24 weeks, training in 6-week blocks with 3-week breaks produced overall muscle size and strength gains similar to continuous training.

In the continuous group the rate of gains slowed after the first 6 weeks, while in the second break-and-retrain cycle the periodic group gained significantly more than the continuous group over the same period.
population: 14 young men; bench press at 75% 1RM, 3 sets of 10, 3 days per week for 24 weeks; periodic group did three 6-week training blocks with 3-week breaks between them
certainty: low; small single RCT (n = 14), one exercise, men only
terms: 停練 休息 退步 回來練 detraining break time off 沒練 白練 出國 放假 好幾週沒練

source.author: Ogasawara
source.title: Comparison of muscle hypertrophy following 6-month of continuous and periodic strength training

summaryZh: 人體肌肉萎縮時肌核會流失，「肌肉記憶」不是靠肌核永久保留，可能跟表觀遺傳等機制有關。
claims: Pooling 147 articles, myonuclei gained with hypertrophy were retained during atrophy in rodents but not in humans.
In humans, both myonuclear content (P = 0.005) and satellite-cell content (SMD -0.49) were lower after atrophy.
The authors conclude myonuclei are not permanent, so myonuclear permanence does not explain muscle memory, and other mechanisms such as epigenetics may matter more.
population: 147 articles across five meta-analyses of human and rodent hypertrophy, atrophy and ageing
certainty: low to moderate for humans; mechanism-level evidence that mixes disuse and atrophy models
terms: 肌肉記憶 肌核 muscle memory myonuclei 沒練 白練 回復

source.author: Rahmati
source.title: Myonuclear permanence in skeletal muscle memory: a systematic review and meta-analysis of human and animal studies
source.journal: Journal of Cachexia, Sarcopenia and Muscle

summaryZh: 人平均會低估自己還能做的次數約 1 下；訓練經驗不會讓人估得更準。
claims: Across 12 studies (414 participants), people underpredicted their remaining reps to failure by 0.95 reps on average (95% CI 0.17-1.73), with very high heterogeneity.
Predictions were more accurate when made closer to failure, with heavier loads (sets of 12 reps or fewer), and in later sets.
Training background did not improve prediction accuracy.
population: 12 studies, 414 healthy participants who predicted their reps to failure in sets taken to failure
certainty: low to moderate; exploratory, very high heterogeneity
terms: 保留次數 估 RIR RPE reps in reserve

source.author: Halperin
source.title: Accuracy in Predicting Repetitions to Task Failure in Resistance Exercise: A Scoping Review and Exploratory Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 血流限制訓練比一般輕重量訓練增肌（0.39）、增力（0.61）較好；跟大重量比，增肌沒差但肌力進步較少。
claims: Across 47 meta-analyses, blood flow restriction exercise had a small effect on hypertrophy (0.39) and a moderate effect on strength (0.61) compared with low-load training without restriction.
Compared with high-load training, it did not differ significantly for hypertrophy (-0.13, p = 0.142) but produced smaller strength gains (-0.28).
All included reviews were rated low to moderate quality.
population: 47 meta-analyses covering 265 unique studies, all populations; all reviews rated low-moderate quality (AMSTAR-2)
certainty: low to moderate; umbrella of low-moderate quality reviews with overlapping studies
terms: 血流限制 加壓訓練 綁帶 BFR blood flow restriction occlusion

source.author: Oborn
source.title: The effect of blood flow restricted exercise on measures of health and physical fitness across all populations: An umbrella review and meta-meta-analysis

summaryZh: 離心超負荷長期下來，肌力和肌肉大小都沒有優勢，但訓練感覺更累。
claims: Across 49 studies (773 participants), accentuated eccentric loading gave chronic gains similar to constant-load training in concentric strength (SMD 0.12), eccentric strength (0.19), isometric strength (0.03) and muscle cross-sectional area (-0.06).
Acutely it raised perceived exertion (SMD 1.72), post-session blood lactate (0.44) and growth hormone (0.50), which the authors say implies longer rests and recovery.
population: 49 studies, 773 participants; accentuated eccentric loading = a heavier load in the lowering phase than in the lifting phase
certainty: low to moderate; 49 studies but small samples and considerable variance in some outcomes
terms: 離心 下放 負向 eccentric negative

source.author: Zhang
source.title: Acute and Chronic Effects of Accentuated Eccentric Loading vs. Constant-Load Resistance Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 長期靜態伸展能小幅增加肌力（d 0.30）和肌肉（d 0.20），但只在高劑量時。
claims: Across 42 studies (1,318 participants), chronic static stretching produced small increases in maximal strength (d = 0.30) and small but significant hypertrophy (d = 0.20).
Longer stretch durations, longer programs and higher frequencies gave small significant effects (d = 0.26-0.28), while lower doses were not significant.
population: 42 randomized controlled trials (at least 2 weeks), 1,318 participants
certainty: low; small effects driven by high-dose protocols
terms: 伸展 柔軟度 拉筋 stretching flexibility

source.author: Warneke
source.title: Effects of Chronic Static Stretching on Maximal Strength and Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis with Meta-Regression

summaryZh: 訓練前靜態伸展會小幅降低最大肌力（−0.21），每次拉 60 秒以上時降很多（−0.84）；跳躍不受影響。
claims: Across 83 studies (2,012 participants), static stretching before testing caused a small loss of maximal strength (effect size -0.21) vs passive controls.
The strength loss was large (effect size -0.84) when stretches lasted 60 s or more per bout.
Stretching did not impair athletic performance in general and slightly improved subsequent jumping in adults (effect size 0.15).
population: 83 controlled pre-post studies, more than 400 effect sizes, 2,012 participants
certainty: moderate; many studies, though strength results come mostly from isolated-muscle tests
terms: 熱身 暖身 warm-up 拉筋 伸展 練前

source.author: Warneke
source.title: Revisiting the stretch-induced force deficit: A systematic review with multilevel meta-analysis of acute effects
source.journal: Journal of Sport and Health Science

summaryZh: 作者建議每肌群每週至少 4 組；超級組、遞減組、休息暫停可以省約一半時間。
claims: The authors recommend at least 4 weekly sets per muscle group with a 6-15 RM load (or 15-40 reps if sets go to volitional failure), and say weekly volume matters more than frequency.
They report that supersets, drop sets and rest-pause roughly halve training time while maintaining volume, but are probably better for hypertrophy than for strength.
They advise limiting the warm-up to exercise-specific warm-up sets and prioritising stretching only if flexibility is a goal.
population: Narrative review of training variables, advanced techniques, warm-up and stretching (expert recommendations, no pooled data)
certainty: low; expert narrative review, recommendations rather than pooled effects
caveats: a narrative review, not a pooled analysis

source.author: Iversen
source.title: No Time to Lift? Designing Time-Efficient Training Programs for Strength and Hypertrophy: A Narrative Review

summaryZh: 重量訓練時補充蛋白質，去脂體重多 0.30 kg、1RM 多 2.49 kg；每天總蛋白超過約 1.62 g/kg 就沒有更多好處。
claims: In 49 RCTs (1863 healthy adults), protein supplementation during at least 6 weeks of resistance training added on average 0.30 kg of fat-free mass and 2.49 kg to 1RM strength compared with training without it.
Total protein intakes above about 1.62 g/kg/day gave no further gain in fat-free mass.
The fat-free-mass benefit of supplementation became smaller with increasing age and was larger in resistance-trained people (0.75 kg).
population: Healthy adults in 49 RCTs (1863 participants) doing resistance training for at least 6 weeks, with or without protein supplementation
certainty: Moderate: large meta-analysis of RCTs, but the effects are modest and the 1.62 g/kg/day figure is a breakpoint estimate from meta-regression, not a hard ceiling that applies to every person.

source.author: Morton
source.title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults

summaryZh: 多吃蛋白質能小幅增加瘦體重；65 歲以上吃到 1.2–1.59 g/kg/天、65 歲以下吃到 1.6 g/kg/天以上時才顯著。
claims: In 62 RCTs with resistance exercise, eating more daily protein gave a small extra gain in lean body mass (SMD 0.22, moderate certainty).
The lean-mass benefit was significant for adults 65 or older eating 1.2-1.59 g/kg/day and for adults under 65 eating at least 1.6 g/kg/day.
Extra protein at 1.6 g/kg/day or more gave only slightly larger lower-body strength gains during resistance training (low certainty).
population: Healthy, non-obese adults in 74 RCTs that raised daily protein intake; 62 studies included resistance exercise; subgroups under 65 and 65 or older
certainty: Moderate for lean mass, low for strength (authors' GRADE); effects are small. The abstract's lower-body strength CI (0.09:0.35) does not contain its point estimate (0.40), likely a typo, so that number should not be quoted to users.
terms: 蛋白質 長者 老人 protein older adults

source.author: Nunes
source.title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of protein intake to support muscle mass and function in healthy adults
source.journal: Journal of Cachexia, Sarcopenia and Muscle

summaryZh: 訓練後吃 100 g 蛋白質，合成反應比 25 g 更大、持續超過 12 小時；多吃的蛋白質大多沒有被氧化「浪費」掉。
claims: In a 12-hour isotope tracer study after exercise, eating 100 g protein produced a larger and longer-lasting (more than 12 h) anabolic response than eating 25 g.

Protein ingestion had a negligible effect on whole-body protein breakdown and amino acid oxidation rates, which the authors say contradicts the belief that protein beyond a small dose is mostly oxidized.
population: 36 healthy, recreationally active young men after a bout of whole-body resistance exercise, randomized to 0, 25 or 100 g milk protein (population and design from the full text; the abstract says only 'humans')
certainty: Low for meal planning: one acute trial in 36 young men, a single post-exercise period with milk protein, measuring protein synthesis rather than muscle growth over weeks.
terms: 一餐蛋白質 吸收上限 30克 一次吃多少 protein per meal absorb

source.author: Trommelen
source.title: The anabolic response to protein ingestion during recovery from exercise has no upper limit in magnitude and duration in vivo in humans

summaryZh: 控制其他因素後，蛋白質什麼時候吃沒有影響，每天總量才是關鍵（也就是「訓練後黃金窗口」的說法沒有根據）。
claims: Without adjusting for other factors, protein timed around training showed a small-to-moderate effect on hypertrophy and no significant effect on strength.
After controlling for covariates, protein timing made no significant difference to strength or hypertrophy, and total protein intake was the strongest predictor of the hypertrophy effect.
population: RCTs of protein timed around resistance training: 20 strength studies (478 subjects) and 23 hypertrophy studies (525 subjects)
certainty: Moderate-low: an older (2013) meta-regression of mostly small trials; it tests timing around the session, not how protein is spread across the day.

source.title: The effect of protein timing on muscle strength and hypertrophy: a meta-analysis
source.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

summaryZh: 植物蛋白長的肌肉略少於動物蛋白（SMD −0.20）；黃豆和牛奶蛋白一樣；肌力沒差。
claims: Across 30 RCTs, plant protein led to slightly lower muscle mass than animal protein (SMD -0.20); the difference was seen in adults under 60 but not in those 60 and over.

Soy and milk protein did not differ for muscle mass (17 RCTs), but animal protein gave more muscle mass than non-soy plant proteins such as rice, chia, oat and potato (SMD -0.58, 5 RCTs) and than plant-based diets (SMD -0.51, 7 RCTs).
There was no significant difference between plant and animal protein for muscle strength (14 RCTs) or physical performance (5 RCTs).
population: Adults in RCTs comparing plant with animal protein (not limited to people who lift); 30 RCTs meta-analysed for muscle mass, 14 for strength, 5 for physical performance
certainty: Low-moderate: the overall effect is small, the non-soy comparison rests on only 5 RCTs, and the studies were not restricted to resistance-trained people.

source.author: Reid-McCann
source.title: Effect of Plant Versus Animal Protein on Muscle Mass, Strength, Physical Performance, and Sarcopenia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

summaryZh: 訓練時補充膠原蛋白肽，去脂體重增加較多（SMD 0.48），肌力略多；沒有跟乳清蛋白比較。

summaryZh: 60 歲以上，快速發力的爆發力訓練跟一般速度的重量訓練效果相近，部分功能測驗略好。
claims: In adults over 60 (19 trials, 1,055 people), high-velocity power training (lifting as fast as possible) had similar effects to traditional moderate-speed resistance training on functional performance overall.
Power training gave slightly better changes on the SPPB (SMD 0.27) and Timed Up and Go (SMD 0.35), based on low-quality evidence and of unclear clinical importance.
population: Adults over 60, regardless of health status, functional capacity or residence; 19 RCTs, 1,055 participants

summaryZh: 青春期前的孩子做重量訓練能增加肌力，不影響身高體重；有監督時受傷很少。
claims: In 22 experimental training studies in pre- and early-pubertal youth, resistance training significantly improved muscular strength, and gains were lost when training stopped.
The training programs did not influence growth in height or weight.
Only 10 studies monitored injuries systematically and only three injuries were reported, in supervised programs with low instructor-to-participant ratios.
population: Pre- and early-pubertal youth in 22 experimental resistance training studies (mostly 8-12 week supervised programs)
certainty: Low to moderate. Older evidence-based (narrative) review of short, supervised trials; injury monitoring was sparse. Supports safety under supervision, not unsupervised maximal lifting.

claims: Across 270 RCTs (15,827 participants), dynamic resistance training lowered resting blood pressure by 4.55/3.04 mm Hg versus control.
Isometric exercise training gave the largest reduction (-8.24/-4.00 mm Hg), and in the network analysis the isometric wall squat ranked as the most effective submode for lowering systolic pressure.
Aerobic (-4.49/-2.53), combined (-6.04/-2.54) and high-intensity interval training (-4.08/-2.50 mm Hg) also lowered resting blood pressure.
population: Participants in 270 RCTs (15,827 people) of exercise training for 2 weeks or more versus a non-exercise control
certainty: Moderate to high for 'exercise lowers resting blood pressure'. The ranking between modes (SUCRA) is probabilistic and should not be read as proof that one mode is best for everyone.

claims: In adults with type 2 diabetes (20 RCTs, 1,172 people), resistance training lowered HbA1c versus control (weighted mean difference -0.39).
Programs that produced bigger strength gains produced bigger HbA1c reductions.
HbA1c changes did not differ significantly between resistance training and aerobic training.
population: Adults with type 2 diabetes in RCTs of resistance training; 20 studies, 1,172 participants
certainty: Moderate. Consistent direction across RCTs but high heterogeneity (I² about 69%).

claims: In 101 postmenopausal women with low bone mass, 8 months of supervised twice-weekly high-intensity resistance and impact training (5 sets of 5 at over 85% 1RM) improved lumbar spine bone density (+2.9% vs -1.2%) and femoral neck density (+0.3% vs -1.9%) compared with a low-intensity home program.
The high-intensity group also improved more on all functional performance measures.
Only one adverse event was reported (a minor lower back spasm).
population: 101 postmenopausal women (mean age 65) with low bone mass (T-score below -1.0), screened for conditions and medications affecting bone
certainty: Low to moderate. A single RCT of 101 screened, otherwise healthy women under highly supervised conditions; promising but needs replication and does not show fracture reduction.

claims: Across 33 RCTs (1,877 adults), resistance training reduced depressive symptoms with a moderate effect (Δ 0.66); the number needed to treat was 4.
Trials with blinded allocation and/or assessment found smaller reductions in depressive symptoms.
population: Adults (healthy or with physical or mental illness) in 33 RCTs (1,877 participants) of resistance training versus a nonactive control
certainty: Moderate. Many RCTs, but high heterogeneity (I² 76%) and smaller effects in better-blinded trials, so the true effect is probably below 0.66.

claims: In adults with chronic non-specific low back pain, exercise reduced pain by 15.2 points on a 0-100 scale versus no treatment, usual care or placebo (moderate certainty), a clinically important difference.
Functional limitations improved by 6.8 points, which did not reach the threshold for a clinically important difference.
Exercise was probably more effective than advice or education alone or electrotherapy, with no difference compared with manual therapy.
population: Adults with chronic non-specific low back pain lasting more than 12 weeks; 249 trials (mean age 43.7, 59% female)

claims: Across 68 RCTs on Achilles and patellar tendinopathy and greater trochanteric pain syndrome, there was no convincing evidence that any adjunct, alone or added to exercise, works better than exercise alone.
The authors recommend exercise alone as first-line treatment for at least 3 months before an adjunct is considered.
Slow resistance exercise looked promising, but only on low or very low strength of evidence.
population: People with Achilles tendinopathy, patellar tendinopathy or greater trochanteric pain syndrome in 68 RCTs that included at least one exercise arm
certainty: Low for differences between specific programs; the recommendation of exercise as first-line care is the firmest takeaway.

claims: In people with knee osteoarthritis, exercise compared with no treatment, usual care or limited education may improve pain by 13.1 points on a 0-100 scale right after the program (low certainty; 56 studies).
Exercise likely improves physical function by 12.5 points on a 0-100 scale (moderate certainty; 54 studies) and slightly improves quality of life (5.4 points).
No differences in effect were found between different types of exercise.
population: People with knee osteoarthritis; 139 trials, 12,468 participants, land-based exercise

claims: Across 25 RCTs (26,610 sports participants), strength training programs reduced sports injuries to less than one third (RR 0.315).
Stretching showed no beneficial effect on injury risk (RR 0.963, 95% CI 0.846-1.095).
population: Sports participants in 25 RCTs (26,610 participants, 3,464 injuries)

claims: Across 20 injury studies of competitive weight-training athletes, bodybuilding had the lowest injury rates (0.24-1 injury per 1000 hours), while strongman (4.5-6.1 per 1000 hours) and Highland Games (7.5 per 1000 hours) had the highest.
The shoulder, lower back, knee, elbow and wrist/hand were the most commonly injured sites, and strains, tendinitis and sprains the most common injury types.
The authors conclude weight-training sports appear to have relatively low injury rates compared with common team sports, although most studies were retrospective.
population: Competitive athletes in weightlifting, powerlifting, bodybuilding, strongman, Highland Games and CrossFit; 20 studies
certainty: Low. Only 5 of 20 studies had low risk of bias and only 4 were prospective. The abstract gives no specific rates for weightlifting or powerlifting.

claims: In healthy adults, stretching before exercise reduced soreness one day later by about half a point on a 100-point scale (3 studies).
One large trial found stretching before and after exercise reduced peak soreness over a week by about 4 points on a 100-point scale, which the authors call very small.
The authors conclude stretching, before, after, or both, does not produce clinically important reductions in delayed-onset muscle soreness.
population: Healthy adults in 12 randomised or quasi-randomised studies, including one field trial of 2,377 participants

summaryZh: 膝蓋骨後方的壓力在膝彎約 90° 時最高，蹲更深反而較低；技術正確時，「深蹲傷膝」的擔心沒有根據。
claims: Based on biomechanical calculations and cadaver knee measurements, the highest compressive forces and stresses behind the kneecap occur at about 90° of knee bend; with further flexion, kneecap compressive forces become lower.

The authors conclude that concerns that deep squats cause cartilage degeneration, chondromalacia or osteoarthritis are unfounded, provided technique is learned under expert supervision with progressive loads.

caveats: a narrative review, not a pooled analysis

claims: In 27 studies of 273 adults, a single aerobic session done fasted oxidized more fat during the session than the same session done fed (weighted mean difference 3.08 g, 95% CI 0.79 to 5.38 g).
Blood glucose and insulin were higher when the session was done fed.
The review measured only what happened during the session (fat oxidation and blood markers), not changes in body fat over weeks.

population: 20 healthy young women on a calorie-restricted diet, 4 weeks, 1 h of steady-state aerobic exercise 3 days/week, either after an overnight fast or after a meal (volume-equated)

population: 8 RCTs in adults doing resistance training, comparing time-restricted eating (8 to 10 h eating windows) with their habitual diet

claims: Across 99 randomized trials (6582 adults), every intermittent fasting style and continuous calorie restriction reduced body weight compared with unrestricted eating.

Compared with continuous calorie restriction, only alternate-day fasting lost more weight, by about 1.3 kg (mean difference -1.29 kg, 95% CI -1.99 to -0.59; moderate certainty); time-restricted eating and whole-day fasting showed no weight benefit over continuous restriction.

claims: In 18 studies of athletes and trained adults, estimates favored carbohydrate-rich diets over keto for 1-RM strength (-5.7%, 95% credible interval -14.9% to 2.6%) and fat-free mass (-0.8 kg, -3.4 to 1.9 kg), but the intervals included no difference.

certainty: Moderate for lifters: a single randomized trial with intention-to-treat analysis, 61 participants, 12 weeks of restriction.

claims: Compared with 2000 steps a day, 7000 steps a day was associated with a 47% lower risk of death from any cause (HR 0.53, 95% CI 0.46 to 0.60; 14 studies).

source.author: Ding
source.title: Daily steps and health outcomes in adults: a systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis

summaryZh: 60 歲以上走到每天 6,000–8,000 步、60 歲以下走到 8,000–10,000 步後，死亡風險不再明顯下降；總步數比速度重要。
claims: Compared with the lowest quarter (median 3553 steps a day), adults in higher quarters had lower mortality: HR 0.60 at a median of 5801 steps, 0.55 at 7842 steps and 0.47 at 10901 steps.
Risk kept falling with more steps until about 6000 to 8000 steps a day in adults aged 60 and older, and until about 8000 to 10000 steps a day in adults younger than 60.

After accounting for total steps, stepping speed mattered less: peak 30-minute cadence remained associated with lower mortality (HR 0.67), but time spent walking at 100 steps per minute or faster was not significantly associated.
population: 15 cohorts, 47471 adults (3013 deaths, median follow-up 7.1 years), participant-level data processed with a standard protocol
certainty: Moderate: large harmonised participant-level analysis, but observational, so associations only.
terms: 走路 步數 一萬步 steps walking 10000

source.author: Paluch
source.title: Daily steps and all-cause mortality: a meta-analysis of 15 international cohorts

summaryZh: 健康成人吃高蛋白（≥1.5 g/kg），腎功能沒有變差。
claims: In 28 randomized trials of 1358 adults without kidney disease, higher-protein diets (≥1.5 g/kg/day, ≥20% of energy or ≥100 g/day) did not change kidney filtration (GFR) differently from normal- or lower-protein diets (SMD 0.11, 95% CI -0.05 to 0.27).
GFR measured only after the diets was trivially higher with high protein (SMD 0.19), which the authors did not interpret as harm.
The authors concluded high protein intakes do not adversely affect kidney function (GFR) in healthy adults, noting unclear risk of selection bias in the trials.
population: 28 RCTs (1358 adults without kidney disease) comparing higher protein (≥1.5 g/kg/day, ≥20% of energy, or ≥100 g/day) with normal or lower protein, lasting more than 4 days
certainty: Moderate: many RCTs, but mostly short, and only GFR was assessed; applies to people without kidney disease.
terms: 高蛋白 傷腎 腎臟 high protein kidney

source.author: Devries
source.title: Changes in Kidney Function Do Not Differ between Healthy Adults Consuming Higher- Compared with Lower- or Normal-Protein Diets: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 高蛋白讓估計的腎絲球過濾率上升，但沒有腎損傷的跡象；長期影響不確定。
claims: In 22 randomized trials of adults without chronic kidney disease, high-protein diets (typically 25% to 35% of energy or at least 2.0 g/kg/day) raised estimated GFR (SMD 0.39, 95% CI 0.09 to 0.69) but did not significantly change serum creatinine (19 trials, 1044 people; SMD 0.08, 95% CI -0.09 to 0.25).

The authors found no consistent biochemical evidence of kidney injury and said the eGFR rise may mainly reflect short-term blood-flow (hemodynamic) adaptation, while long-term kidney effects remain uncertain because trials were short.
High-protein diets also reduced body-fat percentage and fat mass without significantly changing fat-free mass.
population: 22 RCTs in adults without chronic kidney disease, high-protein diets (typically about 25% to 35% of energy or ≥2.0 g/kg/day) vs normal- or low-protein diets
certainty: Moderate to low: newest pooled RCT evidence, but high heterogeneity for eGFR (I² 74.9%), short trials and creatinine-based estimates.
terms: 高蛋白 傷腎 腎臟 high protein kidney

source.author: Teixeira Silva
source.title: Effects of High-Protein Diets on Renal Function and Body Composition in Adults Without Chronic Kidney Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomised Trials

summaryZh: 吃過飯後練、每肌群 10 組以內時，多吃碳水通常不會讓訓練表現更好；量更大時可能有幫助。
claims: Across 49 studies, mostly in strength-trained people, extra carbohydrate usually did not improve strength-training performance: of 19 acute studies, 13 found no benefit and 6 found improvement, mainly when the comparison group was fasted and workouts had more than 10 sets per muscle group.
None of the 7 short-term (2 to 7 day) carbohydrate studies found a benefit, and 15 of 17 longer-term studies found carbohydrate intake did not influence performance changes.

The authors concluded carbohydrate intake itself is unlikely to affect strength-training performance in the fed state for workouts of up to 10 sets per muscle group, while higher-volume sessions may benefit.
population: 49 studies manipulating carbohydrate intake (19 acute, 6 glycogen depletion, 7 short-term, 17 long-term); participants mostly strength trainees or athletes (39 studies)
certainty: Low to moderate: systematic review without meta-analysis (vote counting), heterogeneous designs.
terms: 碳水 澱粉 訓練表現 肝醣 carbohydrate carbs glycogen performance

source.author: Henselmans
source.title: The Effect of Carbohydrate Intake on Strength and Resistance Training Performance: A Systematic Review

summaryZh: 一天吃幾餐，對身體組成沒有影響。
claims: In a meta-analysis of 15 experimental studies, more frequent meals at first appeared linked to more fat loss and more fat-free mass, but sensitivity analysis showed this result came from a single study.
The authors concluded it is doubtful that more frequent meals benefit body composition.
population: 15 experimental studies of meal frequency and changes in fat mass and lean mass
certainty: Low: few studies, and the apparent effect depended on one study.
terms: 一天幾餐 少量多餐 meal frequency

source.author: Schoenfeld
source.title: Effects of meal frequency on weight loss and body composition: a meta-analysis

summaryZh: 節食時蛋白質吃超過 0.8 g/kg，瘦體重少掉約 0.36 kg 的流失。
claims: In randomized trials of healthy adults lasting at least 6 weeks, eating protein above the RDA (0.8 g/kg/day) reduced lean-mass loss during calorie restriction by about 0.36 kg compared with eating at the RDA (95% CI 0.06 to 0.67 kg; 14 comparisons).
With resistance training, protein above the RDA added 0.77 kg of lean mass (95% CI 0.23 to 1.31 kg; only 3 comparisons); with neither dieting nor training, there was no difference (0.08 kg).
population: 18 randomized parallel trials (22 comparisons) in apparently healthy adults aged 19 and older, lasting at least 6 weeks, protein above vs at the RDA (0.8 g/kg/day)
certainty: Moderate: RCTs, but the effect is modest and the resistance-training subgroup has only 3 comparisons.
terms: 節食 高蛋白 保肌 protein diet cutting

source.author: Hudson
source.title: Protein Intake Greater than the RDA Differentially Influences Whole-Body Lean Mass Responses to Purposeful Catabolic and Anabolic Stressors: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

summaryZh: 熱量相同時，高蛋白多減 0.87 kg 脂肪，去脂體重少掉 0.43 kg 的流失。
claims: In 24 trials of 1063 adults on calorie-matched, low-fat weight-loss diets (about 12 weeks), the higher-protein version lost 0.79 kg more body weight and 0.87 kg more fat mass than the standard-protein version.

The higher-protein version also reduced fat-free-mass loss by 0.43 kg (95% CI 0.09 to 0.78 kg) and limited the fall in resting energy expenditure by 595.5 kJ/day (about 142 kcal/day; 95% CI 67.0 to 1124.1 kJ/day).
Greater satiety with higher protein was reported in 3 of 5 studies that measured it.
population: 24 trials, 1063 adults on calorie-matched, low-fat, energy-restricted diets that differed in protein and carbohydrate (mean duration 12.1 weeks)
certainty: Moderate: calorie-matched RCTs, but older and short; the resting-energy-expenditure estimate is imprecise (wide CI).
terms: 節食 高蛋白 保肌 protein diet cutting

source.author: Wycherley
source.title: Effects of energy-restricted high-protein, low-fat compared with standard-protein, low-fat diets: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
source.journal: The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition

summaryZh: 每天約 60–75 分鐘中等強度活動，可以抵消久坐超過 8 小時增加的死亡風險。
claims: In over 1 million adults, sitting more than 8 hours a day was not linked to higher mortality among the most active quarter (more than 35.5 MET-hours a week, about 60 to 75 minutes of moderate activity a day): HR 1.04 (95% CI 0.99 to 1.10) vs people sitting under 4 hours who were also most active.
Low activity carried risk even with little sitting: people sitting under 4 hours a day but in the least active quarter had 27% higher mortality (HR 1.27).
Watching TV for 3 or more hours a day was linked to higher mortality except in the most active quarter, where risk rose only at 5 or more hours a day (HR 1.16).
population: 16 prospective cohort studies; 13 with sitting-time data covering 1005791 adults followed 2 to 18.1 years (84609 deaths); harmonised individual-level analysis
certainty: Moderate: very large harmonised data set, but observational and based on self-reported sitting and activity.
terms: 久坐 坐太久 sitting sedentary

source.author: Ekelund
source.title: Does physical activity attenuate, or even eliminate, the detrimental association of sitting time with mortality? A harmonised meta-analysis of data from more than 1 million men and women

summaryZh: 自由重量和器械長的肌肉一樣；肌力進步看測試用哪種器材。
claims: In 13 studies of 1,016 adults (18-60 years) training at least 6 weeks, free-weight and machine training produced similar muscle growth (SMD -0.055, p = 0.751; 5 studies).
In direct comparison, gains in dynamic strength (SMD 0.084, p = 0.387) and isometric strength (SMD -0.079, p = 0.660) did not differ between the two modalities.

Strength gains were specific to the equipment: strength tested on free weights rose more after free-weight training (SMD -0.210, p = 0.023), and strength tested on machines tended to rise more after machine training (SMD 0.291, p = 0.064, not significant).
population: 13 studies directly comparing free-weight and machine training for at least 6 weeks; 1,016 adults aged 18-60 (789 men, 219 women); hypertrophy measured in 5 studies
certainty: moderate; 13 head-to-head studies with a large total sample, but only 5 measured hypertrophy and participants were mostly men
terms: 器械 自由重量 機器 啞鈴 machines free weights

source.author: Haugen
source.title: Effect of free-weight vs. machine-based strength training on maximal strength, hypertrophy and jump performance - a systematic review and meta-analysis
source.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

summaryZh: 總組數相同時，分部位和全身訓練的肌力、肌肉成長都一樣。
claims: In 14 studies (392 healthy adults), split and full-body routines produced similar strength gains in the bench press (MD 1.19, 95% CI -1.28 to 3.65, p = 0.34) and lower limbs (MD 2.47, 95% CI -2.11 to 7.05, p = 0.29).
Muscle growth was also similar for the elbow extensors, elbow flexors, vastus lateralis and lean body mass (all p >= 0.84).
The authors conclude the choice of routine does not significantly affect strength or hypertrophy when weekly volume is equated.
population: 14 studies, 392 healthy adults comparing split and full-body routines, with volume equated
certainty: moderate; consistent null results across 14 studies, but small total sample, only 4-6 studies per hypertrophy outcome, and findings apply to volume-equated programs
terms: 分部位 全身 課表 split full body

source.author: Ramos-Campo
source.title: Efficacy of Split Versus Full-Body Resistance Training on Strength and Muscle Growth: A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis
source.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research

summaryZh: 超級組省時間，長期肌力和肌肉成長跟一般組一樣；拮抗肌配對能做更多下。
claims: Across 19 studies (313 participants), supersets kept total repetitions (SMD -0.03) and volume load (SMD 0.05) similar to traditional sets while shortening sessions and raising training efficiency (SMD 1.74).
Long-term gains were similar to traditional sets for maximal strength (SMD 0.10, p = 0.36), strength endurance (SMD 0.07) and muscle hypertrophy (SMD -0.05, p = 0.87).
Supersets felt harder (RPE SMD 0.77) and raised blood lactate and energy cost, while perceived recovery was similar (SMD 0.32).

Pairing agonist and antagonist muscles increased the repetitions completed (SMD 0.68), whereas pairing two exercises with similar movement patterns for the same muscles reduced volume load (SMD -1.08).
population: 19 studies, 313 participants comparing supersets with traditional sets (acute sessions and longer training programs)
certainty: moderate for session-level outcomes; low-to-moderate for long-term strength and hypertrophy, which rest on fewer small studies; considerable variance in some outcomes
terms: 超級組 超級組合 supersets

source.author: Zhang
source.title: Superset Versus Traditional Resistance Training Prescriptions: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis Exploring Acute and Chronic Effects on Mechanical, Metabolic, and Perceptual Variables

summaryZh: 遞減組跟一般組的肌肉成長、肌力一樣，但感覺累很多。
claims: In 12 studies (274 participants), drop-set and traditional training produced similar long-term hypertrophy (SMD 0.04, 95% CI -0.29 to 0.36) and strength (SMD -0.04, 95% CI -0.34 to 0.26).
Drop sets raised perceived exertion considerably (SMD 1.62) and blood lactate (SMD 0.67) compared with traditional sets.
population: 12 studies, 274 participants comparing drop-set training with traditional resistance training (search to January 2026)
certainty: low to moderate; newest synthesis, but few small studies (274 participants in total)
terms: 遞減組 drop set

source.author: Havers
source.title: Acute and Chronic Effects of Drop-Set Training: A Meta-Analysis and Systematic Review

summaryZh: 叢集組跟一般組的肌力、爆發力、肌肥大都一樣，可能比較不累。
claims: Across 29 studies, cluster-set and traditional-set programs produced similar gains in strength (ES -0.05, p = 0.56), power (ES 0.02, p = 0.86) and hypertrophy (ES -0.05, p = 0.73).
Results did not change with training volume, cluster-set model, training status, body part trained or exercise type.
The authors suggest cluster sets may reach these adaptations with less fatigue during the session.
population: 29 randomized or non-randomized comparative studies of healthy participants of all ages, interventions of at least 3 weeks
certainty: moderate; 29 studies with consistent null results; the lower-fatigue point is the authors' interpretation, not a pooled long-term outcome
terms: 叢集組 組內休息 cluster sets

source.author: Davies
source.title: Chronic Effects of Altering Resistance Training Set Configurations Using Cluster Sets: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

summaryZh: 進階訓練法對肌肥大沒有比一般多組好；肌力有中度好處，主要來自速度導向訓練和離心超負荷。
claims: Pooling 23 studies in recreationally trained adults, advanced systems (such as rest-pause, drop sets, cluster sets, tempo control, velocity-based training and eccentric overload) did not significantly beat traditional multiple sets for hypertrophy (g = 0.046).
For strength, advanced methods showed a moderate, significant benefit (g = 0.351), driven mainly by velocity-based training and eccentric overload.
Rest-pause showed a modest hypertrophy advantage, while drop sets, tempo-controlled training and cluster-type protocols matched traditional sets when volume and effort were matched.
population: 23 randomized and non-randomized controlled trials in recreationally trained adults aged 18-45, comparing advanced systems with traditional multiple-set training
certainty: low to moderate; preregistered with low heterogeneity, but includes non-randomized trials, appears in a mid-tier journal, and the abstract gives no effect size for the rest-pause finding
terms: 進階訓練法 休息暫停 遞減組 叢集組 rest-pause advanced techniques

source.author: Tsartsapakis
source.title: Effects of Advanced Resistance Training Systems on Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength in Recreationally Trained Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
source.journal: Journal of Functional Morphology and Kinesiology

summaryZh: 新手專注收縮目標肌肉，二頭肌長更多（12.4% 對 6.9%），股四頭沒差。
claims: In 30 untrained college-aged men training for 8 weeks, those told to focus on contracting the target muscle gained more elbow flexor thickness than those focused on the outcome of the lift (12.4% vs 6.9%).
Quadriceps thickness changed similarly with both focus strategies.
Strength differences between the groups (isometric elbow flexion favoured internal focus, knee extension favoured external focus) were not statistically significant.
population: 30 untrained college-aged men; 8 weeks, 3 sessions per week, 4 sets of 8-12 repetitions; internal (focus on contracting the muscle) vs external (focus on the lift outcome) group
certainty: low; a single small trial in untrained men, with the effect seen in the biceps but not the quadriceps
terms: 感受度 專注 肌肉感覺 mind-muscle connection focus

source.author: Schoenfeld
source.title: Differential effects of attentional focus strategies during long-term resistance training

summaryZh: 熱身提高肌肉溫度，每升 1°C 爆發力約多 3.7%，最大力量不變。
claims: Across 33 studies (921 participants), raising muscle temperature improved fast, rate-dependent force (power and rate of force development) by about 3.7% per degree Celsius in voluntary contractions (ES 0.28).
Raising temperature did not improve maximum force (voluntary -0.2% per degree Celsius, ES 0.08, not significant).
Active warm-ups did not beat passive warm-ups for these outcomes, and training status and sex did not change the effect.
population: 33 studies, 921 participants; active (exercise-based) and passive warm-ups that raised muscle or skin temperature
certainty: moderate; 33 laboratory studies, but the authors note too little data for robust subgroup analyses
terms: 熱身 暖身 warm-up 拉筋 伸展 練前

source.author: Wilson
source.title: The effect of muscle warm-up on voluntary and evoked force-time parameters: A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression
source.journal: Journal of Sport and Health Science

summaryZh: 健力選手第一年肌力約進步 7.5–12.5%，10 年後總共只多約 20%。
claims: In a large retrospective sample of competitive powerlifters, the biggest strength gains came early: about 7.5-12.5% in the first year, and only up to about 20% in total after 10 years.
Females tended to progress faster, possibly because of lower starting strength.
Female masters lifters over 59 still gained about 2.5-5.0% in strength, while males over 69 showed a slight loss of about 0.35% per year.
population: large retrospective sample of competitive powerlifters (males and females, across age categories and weight classes); squat, bench press, deadlift and total modelled over years of competition
certainty: moderate for the shape of the curve; observational data from competitive lifters, who are self-selected and already trained when they start competing, so exact percentages may not transfer to recreational gym-goers
terms: 進步多快 新手 一年 進步速度 newbie gains rate of progress

source.author: Latella
source.title: Using Powerlifting Athletes to Determine Strength Adaptations Across Ages in Males and Females: A Longitudinal Growth Modelling Approach

summaryZh: 同一個人重複同一套課表，進步多少相當一致；兩次都沒有反應的人很少。
claims: In 20 untrained adults who did the same 10-week program twice with 10 weeks off between, people who gained more the first time tended to gain more again (r = 0.697 for thigh muscle size, 0.761 for upper-arm muscle size, 0.671 for leg press 1RM).
Individual responses varied, but no one was a non-responder in both rounds for more than one measure; the authors conclude non-response is rare and should not be judged on one measure.
Larger gains in the first round went with larger losses during detraining (upper-arm size r = -0.673; leg press r = -0.488), suggesting bigger gains may also fade faster.
population: untrained men and women aged 32 +/- 5 years; training group (n = 20) did two identical 10-week programs separated by 10 weeks of detraining; control group n = 27
certainty: low to moderate; small trial (47 people) in untrained adults only, but a strong design (repeated intervention plus a control group) for separating real individual differences from noise
terms: 個人差異 天生 基因 沒進步 non-responder genetics individual response

source.author: Räntilä
source.title: Repeated Resistance Training Reveals the Reproducibility of Muscle Strength and Size Responses Within Individuals

summaryZh: 剛開始幾次訓練的肌肉變大主要是水腫，約 18 次後才是真正的肌肥大；肌肉損傷（痠痛）不是增肌的必要條件。
claims: The review argues that increases in muscle size in the first 4 or so sessions are mostly swelling from muscle damage; modest hypertrophy follows after about 10 sessions, and true hypertrophy is seen only after about 18 sessions.
Early rises in muscle protein synthesis after training appear directed to repairing damage and do not correlate with the growth seen after several weeks.
Training protocols that cause little muscle damage still produce similar hypertrophy and strength gains, so the authors conclude muscle damage does not mediate or enhance hypertrophy.
population: review of human resistance training studies on muscle damage, muscle protein synthesis and hypertrophy
certainty: moderate for the conclusion that damage is not required for growth; this is a narrative (not systematic) review, and it addresses muscle damage rather than measuring soreness itself as a predictor
caveats: a narrative review, not a pooled analysis
terms: 痠痛 延遲性痠痛 不痠 沒感覺 DOMS soreness muscle damage

source.author: Damas
source.title: The development of skeletal muscle hypertrophy through resistance training: the role of muscle damage and muscle protein synthesis

summaryZh: 規律跑步的人膝關節炎沒有比較多（OR 0.97）；研究偏誤風險高。
claims: Across 9 case-control studies (12,273 participants, 1,272 runners), regular runners did not have more knee osteoarthritis than controls (OR 0.97, 95% CI 0.56-1.68).
No weekly volume band showed higher prevalence than controls: 8-32.1 km (OR 1.17), 32.2-48 km (OR 1.04) and more than 48 km per week (OR 0.62), all with confidence intervals crossing 1.
Most included studies had high or very high risk of bias, and the authors say it is unclear whether running volume affects knee OA.
population: 9 observational case-control studies, 12,273 participants (1,272 runners); controls ran less than 8 km per week
certainty: low; observational case-control data, mostly high risk of bias, wide confidence intervals
terms: 跑步 膝蓋 傷膝 關節炎 running knees arthritis

source.author: Burfield
source.title: The association between running volume and knee osteoarthritis prevalence: A systematic review and meta-analysis

summaryZh: 休閒跑者髖膝關節炎盛行率 3.5%，不跑的人 10.2%，競賽跑者 13.3%；不能確定因果。
claims: Hip and/or knee OA prevalence was 3.5% in recreational runners, 13.3% in competitive runners and 10.2% in sedentary or non-running controls.

Versus controls, the odds of OA were 0.86 (95% CI 0.69-1.07) in recreational runners and 1.34 (0.97-1.86) in competitive runners; neither interval excludes 1, but the two runner groups differed from each other (P < .001).
Running for less than 15 years was associated with lower odds of hip and/or knee OA than controls (OR 0.6, 95% CI 0.49-0.73).
The authors could not tell whether these associations are causal or confounded by factors such as previous injury.
population: 25 studies (125,810 individuals), 17 meta-analysed (114,829); recreational runners, competitive (elite or international) runners and sedentary or non-running controls
certainty: low; observational data that cannot establish cause and effect, with possible confounding by prior injury
terms: 跑步 膝蓋 傷膝 關節炎 running knees arthritis

source.author: Alentorn-Geli
source.title: The Association of Recreational and Competitive Running With Hip and Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
source.journal: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy

summaryZh: 旋轉肌袖相關肩痛：運動能減少活動時的疼痛（SMD −1.61），但確定性低，沒有哪種運動特別好。
claims: Across 34 RCTs (2,019 people with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain), exercise reduced pain during activity or movement compared with non-exercise controls (SMD -1.61) and with no intervention (SMD -1.87).

Exercise reduced DASH-measured disability versus no intervention (MD -8.50) but not versus other interventions; SPADI scores showed no significant differences, and pain at rest showed no significant effect (only a borderline trend versus no intervention).
Mean adherence was 83.6%, most trials had high risk of bias, certainty was low, and no specific exercise approach was clearly most effective.
population: 34 randomized controlled trials, 2,019 people with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain (search to November 2025)
certainty: low (authors' rating); most trials at high risk of bias and exercise types varied widely
terms: 肩膀痛 肩痛 旋轉肌 夾擠 shoulder pain rotator cuff impingement

source.author: Tena-Portilla
source.title: Effectiveness of exercise in rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: a systematic review with meta-analysis

summaryZh: 肩痛復健要包含肌力訓練或主動運動，外旋等肌力才會進步。
claims: In 28 studies of adults with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain, rehabilitation improved external rotation strength moderately (SMD 0.56) and abduction (SMD 0.47), internal rotation (SMD 0.41), flexion (SMD 0.25) and scaption (SMD 0.48) strength slightly.

Programs that included strength training or active exercises had small-to-moderate effects on all strength outcomes, while interventions without exercise or strength training had no effect on strength.
population: 28 clinical trials or cohort studies of adults with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain (no tears-only or post-surgery samples); interventions of at least 6 weeks; within-group pre-post effects
certainty: low to moderate; effects are within-group changes rather than comparisons with control groups, and heterogeneity was high for some directions
terms: 肩膀痛 肩痛 旋轉肌 夾擠 shoulder pain rotator cuff impingement

source.author: Zhang
source.title: Addressing Shoulder Weakness in Individuals With Rotator Cuff-Related Shoulder Pain: A Systematic Review With Meta-analysis
source.journal: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy

summaryZh: 重量訓練能減輕焦慮症狀（效果量 0.31），健康的人效果更大。
claims: Across randomized trials with 922 participants, resistance training reduced anxiety symptoms compared with non-active controls (effect size 0.31, 95% CI 0.17-0.44).
The effect was larger in healthy participants (0.50) than in people with a physical or mental illness (0.19), though both improved.
Effects did not significantly vary by sex, age, program length, session duration, frequency, intensity, or whether strength improved.
population: 16 articles (31 effects) of randomized trials, 922 participants (mean age 43, 68% female); resistance training vs non-active control
certainty: moderate; randomized trials with low heterogeneity (I-squared 28.3%), but searches end in 2017, comparisons are against non-active controls, and few trials enrolled people with diagnosed anxiety disorders
terms: 焦慮 緊張 壓力 心理 anxiety stress mental health

source.author: Gordon
source.title: The Effects of Resistance Exercise Training on Anxiety: A Meta-Analysis and Meta-Regression Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

summaryZh: 規律重量訓練能改善睡眠，尤其是睡眠品質。
claims: In a systematic review of 13 randomized trials, regular (chronic) resistance exercise improved all aspects of sleep studied, with the greatest benefit for sleep quality.
These benefits of resistance exercise alone were attenuated when resistance exercise was combined with aerobic exercise and compared with aerobic exercise alone.
The effects of a single resistance session on that night's sleep were poorly studied and inconsistent.
population: 13 randomized controlled trials of acute or chronic resistance exercise and sleep
certainty: low to moderate; randomized trials, but only 13, no pooled effect sizes reported in the abstract, and no dose or time-of-day data
terms: 睡眠品質 睡不好 失眠 sleep quality insomnia

source.author: Kovacevic
source.title: The effect of resistance exercise on sleep: A systematic review of randomized controlled trials

summaryZh: 做肌力訓練的人，死亡、心血管疾病、癌症、糖尿病的風險低 10–17%，每週約 30–60 分鐘最好。
claims: Across 16 prospective cohort studies, doing muscle-strengthening activities was associated with a 10-17% lower risk of all-cause mortality, cardiovascular disease, total cancer, diabetes and lung cancer.
For all-cause mortality, cardiovascular disease and total cancer the association was J-shaped, with the largest risk reduction (about 10-20%) at roughly 30-60 minutes per week.
Combining muscle-strengthening and aerobic activity (versus neither) was associated with lower all-cause, cardiovascular and total cancer mortality.
